verdict.rationale: Asana ships rule-based automations, webhooks, API triggers, and AI Studio for no-code autonomous workflows, plus AI Teammates/Agents that operate within workflows with shared memory and context, indicating background/autonomous automation capability. However, evidence is entirely vendor-sourced with no independent/hands-on validation of true autonomous, unattended operation over time. Missing for 10: independent verification of autonomous execution reliability, concrete examples of long-running unattended automations in production, and community confirmation of AI Studio/AI Teammates working as advertised.
